method: open the port, wait until the line has been quiet for 0.5 s, send one byte, read for 5 s, count report headers (H lines); one run of the t27 player is 15200 bytes

old_player.rule: any falling edge of RX queues a start

fixed_player.rule: a falling edge of RX starts a run only while idle, read from the old shift-register values (t27/rtl/fpga_trace_player.t27)

captures: three captures of the 941c16c player (two with 0x72, one with 0xff): PASS, 34 vectors, one run each
